description: Register of dams is a dataset listed in ACT Government open data portal (www.data.act.gov.au), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by ACT Government. This is the register of dams referred to in s.58 of the Act. The register also includes the list of "listed" dams referred to in s.70(b) of the Act. Coverage: Australian Capital Territory. The portal files it under the category Environment. The table has 11 columns. Attribution on the portal: ACT Government. The portal shows 2026-02-19 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-act-gov-au-portal.
